turns.customer: We just adopted a dog, Nova. She's 1 and full of energy. Thinking about daycare.
blocks:
Daycare could be a way for Nova to try structured, supervised socialization. Happy Tails groups dogs by size, age, and temperament, with outdoor play and patio time. The site offers a free group-play evaluation to assess whether a dog fits group play; it doesn’t guarantee a particular placement.

Published rates are **$36 for a single full-day visit**, **$350 for a 10-day pack**, or **$680 for a 20-day pack**. Memberships are **$160/month for 1 day a week**, **$300 for 2 days a week**, **$420 for 3 days a week**, or **$540/month for unlimited visits**. Packs are prepaid and non-refundable. Memberships list guaranteed daycare availability, but I can’t check live openings for a specific date.

Are you thinking of an occasional trial day or a regular weekly routine for Nova?

turns.customer: If I sign up for the $99 unlimited daycare month for Nova, can I also buy a 10-day pack now at a discount too, and use it after the month ends?
blocks:
The published terms don’t confirm that you can buy the **10-day pack now** and save it for after Nova’s $99 month. The pack is **$350**, prepaid and non-refundable, and it can’t be combined with other discounts. The $99 offer is for new dogs, is limited to one per dog, and expires 30 days after purchase; its terms don’t say whether you can buy a pack during the offer and hold it for later. ([Daycare Rates](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/rates) · [$99 Unlimited Daycare offer](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com))

I wouldn’t count on stacking or deferring the pack without checking. Happy Tails staff can clarify that specific question at **(512) 764-6150**.
